properties.name: app.openapi.server-url
properties.description: Explicit server URL injected into the OpenAPI spec. When set, overrides Springdoc's auto-detected URL. In production, resolved from https://${RAILWAY_PUBLIC_DOMAIN}.

properties.name: emit.security.jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for signing and verifying JWT tokens. Must be at least 32 characters.

properties.name: emit.security.jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token validity window in milliseconds. Dev default: 86400000 (24 h).

properties.name: emit.admin.username
properties.description: Username for the built-in admin account seeded on startup.

properties.name: emit.admin.password
properties.description: Password for the built-in admin account seeded on startup.
